headlines.title: White House fact sheet omits Taiwan in Xi-Trump talks - Focus Taiwan
Trump asked Xi if China wanted to buy American weapons, US envoy says
Transcript: Alexander Yui, Taiwan's representative to the U.S., on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," Sept. 27, 2026
No public mentions of Taiwan at official Xi and Trump meeting

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The White House fact sheet omitted Taiwan in the context of Xi-Trump talks, and there were no public mentions of Taiwan at the official Xi and Trump meeting. [1][5]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on whether Puma Shen will win the next Taipei Mayor election is priced Yes at 19% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Nov 29, 2026. [E5]
A Polymarket market on whether China will invade Taiwan by December 31, 2027 is priced Yes at 13% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Jan 1, 2028. [E8]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen whether the US federal government will take a stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, a market that closes Jan 1, 2027. [E6]
The outcome of the Polymarket market on whether China will invade Taiwan by December 31, 2027 is unresolved, closing Jan 1, 2028. [E8]
